Kakko scores twice in 3rd as Kraken hand Oilers their 5th straight loss — Kaapo Kakko scored twice in a two-minute span in the third period and the Seattle Kraken beat Edmonton 4-2 on Friday night, handing the Oilers their fifth straight loss in the opener the home-and-home set.

Penguins snap a 5-game skid with a 6-3 victory over the Sabres — Ben Kindel, Rutger McGroarty, Ville Koivunen and Evgeni Malkin each had a goal and an assist, and the Pittsburgh Penguins beat the Buffalo Sabres 6-3 on Friday night to snap a five-game losing streak.

Mangiapane scores twice, Knight makes 30 saves to help Blackhawks edge Rangers 2-1 — Andrew Mangiapane scored two power-play goals in the first period, Spencer Knight made 30 saves and the Chicago Blackhawks held off the New York Rangers 2-1 on Friday night for their fourth straight victory.

Mats Zuccarello, Andre Lee lead LA Kings past Ducks 5-3 in first Freeway Faceoff of season — Mats Zuccarello scored two goals, Andre Lee got the tiebreaking goal early in the third period and the Los Angeles Kings beat the Anaheim Ducks 5-3 Friday in the first Freeway Faceoff rivalry game of the season.

Short-handed Chicago Blackhawks place Patrick Kane, 38, on injured reserve In a move that was made retroactive to Wednesday, the Chicago Blackhawks placed forward Patrick Kane, 38, on injured reserve because of a lower-body injury before Friday's game against the Rangers and recalled forward Landon Slaggert from AHL Rockford.
